### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you are proposing.

### Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g. multi-node mesh topology, additional cross-reactive sensor support, alternative wireless bridges).

### Proposed Architectural Solution
Describe how this feature should integrate with SENTINEL's dual-tier architecture.

### Edge Safety Considerations
Does this feature affect the local microcontroller actuation loop or fail-safe default behavior?

### Additional Context
Add any other context, references to literature, or mockups here.
